reference_sql:
WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT c.weekday_name, AVG(u.units) AS avg_units
FROM order_units u
JOIN calendar c ON c.cal_date = u.order_day
GROUP BY c.weekday_name

solver.query:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, dayname(o.order_ts) AS weekday_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, dayname(o.order_ts)
)
SELECT weekday_name, AVG(units) AS avg_units
FROM per_order
GROUP BY weekday_name
